entry.name: zl.ecils
entry.digest: Slice a list in reverse order
entry.description: Slices a list in reverse order: output last N out right outlet, the rest out the left. The right outlet is output first.

arguments.name: size
arguments.description: Specify the size of a list that will be output from the right outlet.
